captcha_required.description: ESB Networks is asking for a CAPTCHA for meter {mprn}. Log in at {esb_url} in your browser, then open Settings → Devices & services → ESB Smart Meter → Configure → Provide Session Cookies and paste your cookies. Updates resume automatically once the cookies work.
